title: Applicationcomponent specializes Applicationcomponent
description: An application component is a specialised kind of another component: it inherits the general component's structure and behaviour and refines part of it, and can stand wherever the general one is expected.
x-dr-evidence: A class extending another class of the same codebase where both are modelled as components (class FileStore extends BaseStore, class Owner(Person) with behaviour), recorded by CBM as an INHERITS edge.
